subject: 1. IN VIEW OF ISRAEL'S NAVAL OPERATIONS IN THE EASTERN MEDITERRANEAN SEA,
text:
1. IN VIEW OF ISRAEL'S NAVAL OPERATIONS IN THE EASTERN MEDITERRANEAN SEA,
AND THE EVACUATION OF CIVILIANS FROM LEBANON, MARITIME COMPONENT
COMMAND (MCC) NORTHWOOD HAS ACTIVATED THE NATO SHIPPING CENTER (NSC)
TO PROVIDE ADVICE AND GUIDANCE TO MERCHANT SHIPS FROM THE NATO
MEMBER NATIONS IN THE AREA.
2. THE PURPOSE OF ACTIVATING THE NSC IS PRIMARILY TO COLLECT AND
DISTRIBUTE INFORMATION RELEVANT FOR THE SAFE PASSAGE OF VESSELS IN THE

MEDIA:

       ACTIVE ENDEAVOUR (OAR) VOLUNTARY REPORTING PROGRAM.
   C. A CONTINUOUS WATCH ON THE NSC FREE PHONE NUMBER +44 1923 843574 OR
       FREE FAX +44 1923 853575.

OPERATION ACTIVE ENDEAVOUR (OAR), NO ADDITIONAL REPORTING PROGRAM FOR
SHIPS WILL BE ESTABLISHED FOR THE EASTERN MEDITERRANEAN SEA.

subject: 1. MILITARY FORCES WILL EXERCISE NAVAL CO-OPERATION AND
text:
1. MILITARY FORCES WILL EXERCISE NAVAL CO-OPERATION AND
   GUIDANCE FOR SHIPPING (NCAGS) OPERATIONS FOR THE
   PERIOD 29 SEP THRU 13 OCT 06 AT THE AREA PORT VENDRES, FRANCE
   TO THE WEST AND CORSICA ISLAND TO THE EAST, INCLUDING THE GULF
   OF LIONS, SOUTHERN FRENCH COAST AND TERRITORIAL WATERS.
   CO-OPERATION OF MERCHANT SHIPS WILL BE OF SIGNIFICANT VALUE
   FOR THE EXERCISE. YOUR SHIP MAY HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO
   PARTICIPATE IN ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWING LEVELS OF
   CO-OPERATION, ON A NO-COST/NO DELAY BASIS:
   LEVEL 1: COMMUNICATION INTERROGATION.
   LEVEL 2: CLOSE APPROACH BY NAVAL UNITS.
   LEVEL 3: ACCOMPANIMENT (ESCORTING).
   LEVEL 4: SIMULATED ATTACKS BY AIRCRAFT, HELICOPTERS AND SHIPS.
   LEVEL 5: SIMULATED BOARDING.
   LEVEL 6: LIVE BOARDING.
2. ADDITIONALLY, IT WILL BE OF GREAT INTEREST FOR THE NAVAL UNITS,
   IF YOU ARE WILLING TO MAKE YOUR SHIP AVAILABLE FOR LIVE BOARDING
   (LEVEL 6). A LIVE BOARDING MAY BE EXECUTED BY BOAT OR HELICOPTER.
   LIVE BOARDING SHOULD ONLY IMPLY MINOR DELAY FOR YOU.
   YOU ARE KINDLY REQUESTED TO INFORM THE NATO SHIPPING CENTRE
   ABOUT YOUR WILLINGNESS TO PARTICIPATE, AND TO WHICH LEVELS. (FORMAT
   ALFA-INITIAL REPORT TO BE SENT 24 HOURS IN ADVANCE BEFORE ENTERING
   THE NCAGS AREA-).
3. IF YOUR PERMISSION TO CO-OPERATE (ESPECIALLY LIVE BOARDING) IS GIVEN,
   YOU SHOULD REPORT YOUR POSITION TO THE NATO SHIPPING CENTRE
   AT LEAST EVERY THREE HOURS UNDER (FORMAT ALFA-SHORT VERSION-).
   ONE OF THE PARTICIPATING NAVAL UNITS OR THE BOARDING COORDINATOR
   AT SHIPPING CO-OPERATION POINT IN MARSEILLE, MAY CONTACT YOU
   FOR FURTHER DETAILS.
4. VESSELS ARE INVITED TO CONTACT NATO SHIPPING CENTRE BY:
   PHONE: 44 1923 843574, FAX: 44 1923 843575.
5. CANCEL THIS MSG 14 OCT.

subject: 1. EXERCISE OF NAVAL CONTROL OF MARITIME TRAFFIC (CNTM) WITH THE
text:
1. EXERCISE OF NAVAL CONTROL OF MARITIME TRAFFIC (CNTM) WITH THE
   PURPOSE OF TRAINING BRAZILIAN ORGANIZATION OF NAVAL
   CONTROL OF MARITIME TRAFFIC (ORGACONTRAM) AND PROVIDE INFORMATION,
   ADVERTENCE AND/OR PROTECTION, BEFORE A THREAT TO MERCHANT TRAFFIC
   IN MARITIME AREA OR HYDROWAY VICINITY, WHERE VESSELS ARE TRANSITING
   OR WILL TRANSIT 03 THRU 13 NOV.
   A. GENERALITIES: THE PRESENT INSTRUCTIONS APPLY TO MERCHANT SHIPS, THAT
      IN PERIOD 03 THRU 13 NOV PARTICIPATE SPONTANEOUS
      IN CITED CNTM EXERCISE CNTM. IT IS SALIENTED THAT,
      DURING PARTICIPATION IN EXERCISE, NO ALTERATION WILL
      OCCUR IN CRUISER CINEMATIC CARRIED OUT BY VESSELS,
      NEITHER ANY PREJUDICE TO SHIP OWNER/OPERATOR. THEREFORE,
      THEY WILL ONLY COOPERATE WITH ORGACONTRAM, SENDING
      INFORMATION THAT PERMIT MARITIME TRAFFIC ACCOMPANYING.
      A SHIPPING RISK AREA WILL BE CREATED, WHERE M/V WILL BE
      PROTECTED IN SIMULATION BY NAVAL FORCE.
   B. PROCEEDING TO BE EDOPTED BY MERCHANT VESSELS:
      1. VESSEL AT SEA NAVIGATING BETWEEN PARALLELS: 26S
         AND 34S E AT WEST OF MERIDIAN 048W, DURING
         PERIOD 05 TO 13 NOV, SEND MSG NAMED FORMAT
         ALFA TO COMANDO DO CONTROLE NAVAL DO TRAFEGO MARITIMO
         USING E-MAIL: controle@cotram.mar.mil.br, TELEPHONES:
	 (21) 2104-6353/2104-6337, TELEX: 2130933/2136931, FAX
	 (21) 2104-6341. MSG MODEL FORMAT ALFA IS IN INSTRUCTIONS.
      2. VESSEL MOORED OR ANCHORED IN PORTS IN PARANA, SANTA
	 CATARINA AND RIO GRANDE DO SUL STATES, WITH PRESENCE
	 ORGACONTRAM AUTHORITY (CAPITANIA, DELEGACIA OR AGENCIA
	 DA CAPITANIA DOS PORTOS), WITH PREVISION TO DEPART
	 BETWEEN 05 TO 13 NOV, FILL MODEL FORMAT
	 ALFA  TO BE PRESENTED BY REPRESENTATIVE OF ORGACONTRAM
	 AUTHORITY THAT MAY VISIT VESSEL AS OF 03 NOV.
	 IF VESSEL IS NOT VISITED BY THE CITED REPRESENTATIVE
	 UNTIL ITS DEPARTURE, IT SHOULD PROCEED AS STATED IN ITEM 1.
   C. INFORMATION MENTIONED IN ITEMS ABOVE WILL PERMIT
      CNTM AUTHORITIES ACCOMPANY VESSEL TRANSIT THROUGH MARITIME
      AREA, BEYOND TO BE ABLE TO PROVIDE ORIENTATION REGARDING
      SAFETY OF ITS NAVIGATION.
      SUCH ORIENTATIONS/ADVERTENCES OR WARNINGS MAY BE SENT
      TO VESSEL STRAIGHTLY THROUGH VHF CHANNEL 16 CALL OR
      RADIO NAVIGATIONAL WARNINGS.
   D. COMMANDERS ARE FREE TO PROCEED THEIR TRANSIT OFFWARD
      THE ROUTE THEY DECLARED, WITHOUT NECESSITY TO TAKE OTHER
      ACTIONS.
   E. WHEN DECLARE VOYAGE INTENTION BY A MARITIME AREA AND
      THERE IS NECESSITY TO ALTER THE ROUTE, THE NEW VOYAGE
      INTENTION SHOULD BE INFORMED TO ORGACONTRAM BY MSG
      WITH TITLE FORMAT ALFA PASSAM, ALSO CONTAINED IN THESE
      INSTRUCTIONS.
2. FORMAT ALFA PASSAM  WILL UPDATE FORMER INFORMATION
   ISSUED BY A MSG/MODEL FILLED FORMAT ALFA.
   A. FORMAT ALFA:
      WILL BE EMITTED CLEARLY VIA COMMERCIAL CHANNELS BY
      MERCHANT VESSELS, AT SEA OR PORT WITHOUT PRESENCE
      OF ORGACONTRAM AUTHORITY, WITH ADDRESSEE COMANDO
      DO CONTROLE NAVAL DO TRAFEGO MARITIMO, INFORMING: ITS
      POSITION AND PRESENT INTENTION OF MOVEMENT TO THE
      IMMEDIATE DESTINY.
   B. THE MSG TEXT WILL COMPLY WITH THE MODELS AS
      FOLLOWING:
      1. THE DATE EMPLOYED MAY BE EXPRESSED EXTENSIVELY
	 EX: 05 JUN 06 21.00 UTC) OR BY DATE-TIME GROUP (GDH).
      2. DATE-TIME GROUP (GDH) SHOULD BE EXPRESSED IN TIME
         ZONE ZULU, IN FOLLOWING FORMAT DDHHHHMMMYYZ (EX:202100JUN06Z).
3. MODEL FORMAT ALFA:
   A. DATA OF VESSEL:
      1. NAME OF SHIP.
      2. INDICATIVE INTERNATIONAL RADIO.
      3. TYPE OF SHIP.
      4. FLAG OF REGISTRATION.
      5. IMO NUMBER.
      6. PORT OF REGISTRATION.
      7. LENGTH.
      8. MOUTH.
      9. SPEED: SPEED OF CRUISE, MAXIMUM SPEED AND MINIMUM SPEED.
      10. MAIN CHARACTERISTIC OF MERCHANT SHIP FOR VISUAL
           RECOGNITION.
      11. INMARSAT/SELECTIVE CALL NUMBER.
      12. NAME OF COMMUNICATION STATION ON WATCH.
      13. FACSIMILE NUMBER.
      14. E-MAIL OR TELEX NUMBER.
      15. OTHER MEANS OF COMMUNICATION.
   B. DATA OF VOYAGE:
      1. INTENTION OF MOVEMENT AND DESCRIPTION OF VOYAGE
      2. LAST VISITED PORT, COUNTRY AND ETD.
      3. NEXT PORT OF DESTINY AND ETA.
      4. CURRENT POSITION.
      5. GDH AND POSITION OF ENTRANCE IN AREA DELIMITED
         BY FOLLOWING COORDINATES:
         POINT 1: 31-40S 050-00W,
         POINT 2: 31-40S 051-00W,
         POINT 3: 33-50S 050-00W,
         POINT 4: 33-50S 051-00W.
      6. LIST VOYAGE PLAN COORDINATES INSIDE
         THE AREA CITED ABOVE (GDH-LATITUDE/LONGITUDE).
      7. POSITION AND GDH OF EXIT OF THE AREA.
   C. DATA OF SHIP OPERATOR:
      1. NAME AND ADDRESS OF SHIP OWNER AND
         OPERATOR/PERSON THAT CHARTERED, IF THERE IS ONE.
      2. FLAG OF SHIP OPERATOR.
      3. E-MAIL OF SHIP OPERATOR.
      4. TELEPHONE NUMBER OF SHIP OPERATOR.
      5. NUMBER OF FACSIMILE OF SHIP OPERATOR.
   D. DATA OF CARGO:
      1. AMOUNT AND NATURE OF MAIN CARGO.
      2. DISPATCHERS OF MAIN CARGO (NAME AND ADDRESS).
      3. ORIGIN OF MAIN CARGO.
      4. CONSIGNEE OF MAIN CARGO.
      5. FINAL DESTINATION OF MAIN CARGO.
      6. APPLICABLE SPECIAL CONDITIONS TO CURRENT
         OPERATION, SUCH AS "INFORM IF SOME PERSON OR
         CARGO BEING TRANSPORTED IS SUBJECT TO U.N. SANCTION,
         INDICATING YES OR NO  (IN CASE OF YES, TO DESCRIBE THE 
         SITUATION IN A SEPARATE SHEET)."
4. MODEL FORMAT ALFA PASSAM:
   REFERENCE TO FORMER MSG FORMAT ALFA. EMITTED IN CLEAR LANGUAGE,
   VIA COMMERCIAL CHANNEL BY MERCHANT VESSELS, AT SEA TO COMANDO DO
   CONTROLE NAVAL DO TRAFEGO MARITIMO INFORMING ALTERATIONS IN
   MSG FORMAT ALFA, MODIFYING ONLY THE SECTIONS THAT WILL BE ALTERED.
5. CANCEL THIS MSG 14 NOV.
